llm.summary: This is a documentation-only APIDot image API skill that discloses its optional API key use and contains no executable code.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is APIDot image-generation integration guidance, and the artifact contains only markdown instructions, model-routing links, async workflow notes, and security guidance aligned with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to helping users choose APIDot docs/examples, handle async tasks, polling, and webhooks; live API calls are explicitly limited to user request and safe server-side environments.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The installed artifact is a single non-executable SKILL.md file; no scripts, package hooks, binaries, or hidden companion files were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares optional APIDOT_API_KEY usage, which is sensitive but expected for API integration and paired with clear guidance to keep it server-side and out of logs, browsers, repos, screenshots, and chat output.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not create persistence or request elevated privileges; persistence guidance is limited to application-design advice such as storing task IDs and final image URLs for user workflows.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to build with APIDot image APIs; keep any APIDOT_API_KEY in server-side secrets, verify current APIDot docs before coding against model-specific fields, and only allow live API calls when you explicitly want them.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; this matches the reviewed artifact, which is documentation-only and has no executable components.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean across supplied engines; this is supportive but not decisive, and artifact review found no conflicting suspicious behavior.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no findings; local inspection confirmed only one markdown skill file and no scripts or install-time execution.
